name: Cool Caps Industries Limited
summary: Cool Caps Industries Ltd. engages in the business of manufacturing a wide range of plastic caps and closures which include soda bottle caps and mineral water bottle caps, along with embossed, debossed and printed closures as per client specifications from units situated in Kolkata, West Bengal and Kotdwar, Uttarakhand. The company was founded on November 20, 2015, and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
